title: Edu Summit — pocket admin notes + receipts cues
content:
Quick reference for onsite admin, vendors, and expense submission — messy personal notes.

Event: EduTech Summit (fall regional) — Javits Center NYC
Dates: Nov 12–14, 2024 (arrive evening 11/11, depart 11/15 morning)
Primary objective: booth ops + three customer meetings + panel talk (Tue 11/12 2:15pm)
Attendees on expense sheet: Olivia Park, Ethan Li, Samira Khan
Project code to use on expenses: EDU_SUM24 (required)

Preflight checklist (day -7 to -1)
- Confirm badge pickup window and registration code: confirm via organizer portal (code: REDWOOD-EDU24). Screenshot confirmation.
- Booth ship: crate arrives to Javits 11/10 - confirm carrier (BlueHawk Logistics) ETA and signature person (Ethan). Add tracking emails to receipts folder.
- Hotel: Marriott Marquis — reservation under Redwood Inference (Olivia). Nightly rate: $289 + tax. Ask front desk for itemized folio at checkout (required for corporate card reconciliation).
- Airport transfer: book Lyft XL for team to/from airport. If using rideshare receipt, forward app receipt to expenses@redwood.com and tag with "ground-edu".
- AV/cater: organizer handles table power; we contracted extra power strip via Exhibitor Services (vendor contact below). Keep invoice and pickup slip.
- Print materials: 300 one-pagers, 50 postcards. Vendor: PaperTrail NYC (receipt + invoice needed).

Receipt capture rules (short version)
- Photo everything immediately (phone camera + Slack DM to #travel-receipts if urgent).
- Digital invoices: save PDF and attach to expense item; filename format: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_currency.pdf
- If receipt is missing (taxis, tiny coffee): add a short note in the expense line: "no receipt — card swipe 11/12 $7.24" and take screenshot of card statement showing charge.
- Foreign currency: convert using XE rate on date of transaction and include exchange screenshot.

Expense categories (preferred tags)
- hotel_accom — use when lodging on corporate card or reimbursing personal card
- meals — break out by team vs. client (meals_client)
- ground_trans — shuttles, fares, rideshare, parking
- booth_ops — shipping, power, furniture, printing, swag
- travel_air — airfare and baggage fees
- other_incidental — cab office supplies, last-minute adapter, etc.

Per-diem and company rules
- Meals: up to $70/day for NYC team travel; itemize when > $25 per meal.
- Alcohol: allowable if part of client dinner, but must be <30% of total and flagged as meals_client_alcohol with manager note.
- Tipping: standard local rates (15–20%); submit receipt.
- Corporate card preferred for vendor charges >$250. Use personal reimbursements for small items if card not available.

Vendor contacts (short rollup)
- Hotel — Marriott Marquis NYC: main line (212) 123-4567; group reservations team: reservations@marriottmqt.com — folio requests desk@marriottmqt.com (ask for itemized).
- Booth shipping / exhibitor services — BlueHawk Logistics: ops@bluehawklogistics.com; pickup contact Jorge Martinez +1-917-555-0190
- Onsite power / AV extras — ExhibitPowerNY: invoices@exhibitpowerny.com; rep: Dana R. mobile +1-646-555-0027
- Printing / handouts — PaperTrail NYC: invoicing@papertrailnyc.com; turnaround 48h for rush jobs
- Badge & registration vendor — SummitReg LLC: support@summitreg.io; portal: summitreg.io/edu24
- Local taxi company (backup): YellowFleet — dispatch +1-212-555-0071 (use when rideshare not available).

Quick templates (copy-paste into expense form)
- Business purpose: "Booth staffing + customer meetings at EduTech Summit — product demos and partner outreach"
- Attendees: "Olivia Park, Ethan Li — internal; Samira Khan — internal; (client: Acme Learning — meeting 11/12 11:30am)"
- Justification for over-budget meals: "Client dinner — product deep dive; meals_client; manager approved via Slack #sales-ops 11/05/24"

Open questions / to resolve (notes-to-self)
- Confirm whether PaperTrail will accept consolidated invoice for all print runs or if need per-delivery receipts. (Action: Samira to confirm 11/01)
- Who submits final booth_ops package to finance? (Tentatively Ethan will collate receipts and upload to Concur.)
- Do we need to pre-authorize extra electric on booth? Organizer gave conditional approval but requires firm PO by 11/05. (Action: Olivia)

Onsite ops quick map (high-level)
- Booth: Hall B, row 8, table G23. Power outlet on left side of table.
- Shipping drop-off: Loading Dock C (11/10 08:00–18:00) — gate code emailed from BlueHawk
- Staff check-in: Exhibitor entrance (south side). Badge pickup opens 07:30 each day.

Post-event reconciliation steps (after return)
- Day +2: collect all physical receipts and folios; photograph and upload to expense system; label each with transaction date and project code EDU_SUM24.
- Day +4: Ethan to compile booth_ops spreadsheet with line items, invoice copies, and payment method; submit consolidated vendor invoice to Finance (acct: ops-payments@redwood.com).
- Day +7: file expense report in Concur (or the internal expense portal) and flag for priority review (because this spend is Q4 marketing).

Notes for quick receipts upload (phone tips)
- Use the company expense app if signal weak — app saves offline and syncs when back to Wi‑Fi.
- Filename convention again: 20241112_PaperTrail_print_150USD.pdf
- When forwarding rideshare emails, include the card last4 in the email body for quick match if multiple cards used.

Personal packing shorthand (Olivia)
- Tech: MacBook Pro + charger, USB-C hub, spare dongle (HDMI), phone charger, portable battery, presentation clicker
- Booth: pop-up banner velcro straps, spare tape, velcro ties, multi-strip power extension (check weight limit)
- Misc: business cards x150, spare sneakers (long floor), light rain jacket

Chit-chat / meeting prep cues (so I don't forget)
- Panel notes: bring 3 talking points about latency/cost tradeoffs and Redwood Dedicated benefits for regulated customers — keep examples short (<60s each)
- Customer demo: load demo model with higher-latency fallbacks to show graceful degradation; check internet/edge plan with organizer in booth (wifi often flaky)

Final reminders (day of travel)
- Put physical receipts in envelope in laptop bag (label "EDU24").
- Charge devices before leaving hotel.
- DM Ethan on arrival at Javits and reconfirm meeting times with clients 24h in advance.

Random TODOs (quick)
- [ ] Samira: confirm printing invoice policy with PaperTrail (due 11/01)
- [ ] Ethan: create booth_ops spreadsheet template (due 11/06)
- [ ] Olivia: submit PO for extra power to organizer (due 11/05)

-- end of notes --

(If I forget anything, check Confluence page linked above or ping #events-planning channel. These are my raw operational notes — not a polished checklist for others.)
